article.articleHeadline: نيجيريا ترصد حالتين مشتبها بإصابتهما بفيروس "إيبولا" في الشمال الشرقي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria detects two suspected Ebola virus cases in northeast Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola virus cases are under investigation in northeastern Nigeria by the Nigerian Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC). The patients are isolated, with contact tracing underway and laboratory tests being conducted to confirm infection; results are pending. Nigeria previously announced a confirmed Ebola case on October 20, 2026—a Bundibugyo-strain infection in a woman who traveled from Uganda to Abuja—making Nigeria the fifth country to report infections linked to the ongoing outbreak. The World Health Organization had on May 17 declared the Congo and Uganda situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with high regional risk. Across Africa, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths over five decades; the 2018–2020 outbreak was the deadliest, with about 2,300 deaths from roughly 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、北東部でエボラウイルス感染の疑いがある2例を検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大の3基準に該当し、DRC/ウガンダ発のエボラ流行がナイジェリアへ拡大したことを示す事象であるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの疑い例検出だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。背景として言及されるWHOがPHEICを宣言したコンゴ(DRC)・ウガンダの流行のうち、DRCのみ対象国リストに該当するため記載。ウガンダは対象国リスト外。続報での確定診断結果の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola death toll surpasses 5,000 as virus continues to spread
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-31, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 10,351 infections and 5,026 deaths from the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, with 1,101 patients in treatment or quarantine and 2,788 recoveries. The outbreak, detected mid-May, may be underestimated with undetected transmission since February. The Bundibugyo strain lacks an approved vaccine or targeted treatment, hindering containment; early symptoms resemble malaria, with possible severe fever, diarrhea, and bleeding. Cases have appeared abroad: a Kenyan national who contracted the virus in Congo died, triggering Kenyan cases; Nigeria reported its first Ebola case on Oct 20—the Swiss woman who had returned from Uganda; Europe has one case in France (doctor) who recovered after a mission in eastern Congo. Two antiviral trials have been ongoing since July, and vaccines are under evaluation, including Ervebo, currently approved only for the Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者数5,000人を超え拡大続く
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が死者5,000人超に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランスでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株であり、初期症状がマラリアに類似するため診断遅延のリスクもある。

article.articleHeadline: نيجيريا ترصد حالتين يشتبه في إصابتهما بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria detects two suspected cases of Ebola virus infection
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola virus cases in northeastern Nigeria are under investigation by the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) as of 31 October 2026. The two individuals have been isolated, with contact tracing ongoing and laboratory testing to confirm infection; cases remain in the suspected phase pending results. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola deaths have surpassed 5,000, with 5,026 fatalities among 10,351 laboratory-confirmed cases, yielding a case fatality rate near 50%. The report signals ongoing transmission and the public health challenge in the DRC. The article does not provide details on the infection source or any imported/exported cases. Together, the updates reflect active surveillance, isolation of suspected Nigerian cases, and the substantial burden of Ebola in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラウイルス感染疑いの2症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱による死者が5,000人を超え致死率約50%と深刻な公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアの疑い例は対象国リストに含まれず、確定症例でもないため除外。DRCの大規模流行（致死率約50%）が本記事の主要な公衆衛生上の懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa manda recolher linguiça com bactéria Listeria - Correio de Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa orders recall of sausages containing Listeria bacteria - Correio de Minas
article.articleSummary: Brazilian health regulator Anvisa ordered the recall of a batch of smoked pork sausage from Zanetti Embutidos Ltda. (KF Embutidos) after microbiological analysis detected Listeria monocytogenes in a product sample, the bacterium that causes listeriosis, a serious foodborne infection. The lot, dated 21 October 2026, was prohibited from sale, distribution, advertising, and use. The recall directs removal of the affected batch from the market and halts any further activity related to it. No illnesses or case counts are reported in the article. KF Embutidos was contacted for comment about the voluntary recall; the newspaper reported no response at publication. This action reflects Brazil’s regulatory measures to prevent exposure to contaminated meat products and protect consumer health.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、リステリア菌混入のソーセージの回収を命令 - Correio de Minas
triage.triage_reason: 単一製造者の製品ロットに対する予防的リコールであり、症例報告もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 症例数・発症報告なし。単発の食品安全規制対応であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola deja más de 5 mil muertos y 10 mil infectados en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak leaves more than 5,000 dead and 10,000 infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 5,000 deaths and reached 10,351 confirmed infections as of Oct 29, with a 48.6% lethality and 84.5% contact-tracing coverage. Over 2,788 have recovered and 1,101 are hospitalized or in isolation. The epidemic began May 15 in eastern DRC and has spread to additional provinces. The Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; WHO and partners are testing two vaccines in phase 1 trials, while DRC began immunization with Ervebo in late August, originally for the Zaire strain but showing some activity against Bundibugyo in animals. Cases linked to the outbreak have emerged beyond DRC: Uganda (20 cases, 15 imported, 2 deaths; end of outbreak declared Aug 26), Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), Nigeria (1 case), and a France-linked case with three evacuees sent to the Netherlands (1) and Germany (2) after exposure in DRC. The UA and WHO urge coordinated action as ~80% of new cases occur outside known transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行、死者5000人以上・感染者1万人超に
triage.triage_reason: 死者5000人超・感染者1万人超という大規模流行で、複数国への感染拡大（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、欧州への輸出例）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス、オランダ、ドイツへの関連症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。致死率48.6%、Bundibugyo株で特異的治療法なし、新規症例の約80%が既知の感染経路外で発生という点から、感染制御上の重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Khám sàng lọc bệnh lao cho bà con dân tộc Chứt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis screening for the Chứt ethnic group
article.articleSummary: On Oct 30, Ha Tinh Lung Hospital, in collaboration with Phuc Trach Commune Health Station, conducted a free screening drive for nearly 200 residents of the Chứt ethnic group and other underprivileged people in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam. The program used ultrasound, mobile chest X-ray, Mantoux tuberculin skin testing, sputum analysis for Mycobacterium tuberculosis, and spirometry to detect chronic respiratory diseases such as COPD and asthma, aiming to identify active tuberculosis, latent tuberculosis infection, and other pulmonary conditions early. Free examinations and counseling were provided, with health education on TB prevention, environmental hygiene, and recognition of warning signs—prolonged cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, fever, or unexplained weight loss. Participants are advised to seek medical care promptly if symptoms arise. Early detection helps reduce transmission and protect families and the community.

triage.headline_ja: チュット族への結核スクリーニング検査
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生活動（無料結核スクリーニング）の報告であり、異常事態や感染拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の医療アウトリーチ・啓発活動であり、新規アウトブレイクやクラスターの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: কঙ্গোতে ভয়াবহ রূপ নিয়েছে ইবোলা, মৃতের সংখ্যা ছাড়াল ৫ হাজার
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Has Taken a Horrific Turn in the Congo; Death Toll Has Surpassed 5,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has taken a horrific turn in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with deaths surpassing 5,000. The outbreak spans 8 of the 26 provinces, with confirmed cases exceeding 10,300 and an estimated case fatality rate of 48.6%. Ituri province in the northeast remains the epicenter amid ongoing conflict that impedes access and outbreak control. The virus belongs to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage, for which no proven treatment or effective vaccine exists. Cross-border transmission has reached Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda; Uganda reports 20 infections and 2 deaths, with no new cases since August, though travel restrictions persist. Kenya has 9 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; Nigeria has 2 suspected cases under isolation, and one previously infected woman was treated in Switzerland. The UN and WHO urge expanded reach, awareness, and large-scale response. Europe’s risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが深刻化、死者数が5000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8州に拡大し死者5000人超・致死率48.6%と深刻で、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主たる発生国であり、紛争による対応阻害が長期化要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Saudi Arabia suspends travel to Kenya, halts visa issuance
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (declared May 2026) has spread to Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, and France, prompting Saudi Arabia to suspend travel for its citizens to Kenya and halt visa issuance for travellers from Kenya. Entry is prohibited for travellers arriving directly from Kenya or who have stayed in Kenya or any country with an active Ebola outbreak within the prior 21 days. The measures follow June suspensions of travel to/from the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan and ongoing Weqaya surveillance. As of 28 October, the DRC reported 10,274 confirmed cases and 4,992 deaths; Kenya 9 cases (2 deaths); Uganda 20 cases (2 deaths); Nigeria 1 case (0 deaths). Nigeria also reported two suspected cases in the North-east, isolated pending laboratory confirmation; France has reported imported cases as well.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：サウジアラビア、ケニアへの渡航を停止しビザ発給も停止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランスへ国際拡大し、多数の死者とともに渡航制限措置が実施されており、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSudan, France, Saudi Arabia, Kenya, Uganda, Nigeriaが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・フランスは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 5340 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 5,340.
article.articleSummary: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 5,340, with 10,351 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases recorded as of Oct 29, 2026, according to the Ministry of Health in Kinshasa (datelined Nov 1, 2026). The case fatality rate is 51.6%. The figures come from the ministry’s website and reflect ongoing transmission in the affected areas of the DRC. The article provides no additional details on infection sources, laboratory confirmation, or exported/imported cases. The data underscore the substantial mortality burden of the outbreak and the need for continued surveillance, clinical management, and public health measures in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱による死者数が5,340人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 致死率51.6%と高い公衆衛生影響を示すエボラ出血熱の大規模継続流行であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 致死率51.6%、累計症例10,351人、死者5,340人という大規模かつ継続的なアウトブレイクであり、感染源や検査確認状況など詳細情報は不明。既存の進行中アウトブレイクである可能性が高く、異常性は低いが規模・重症度の観点からPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Врач Шахмарданов рассказал об осложнениях лихорадки Зика у беременных
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Shakhmardanov explained the complications of Zika fever in pregnant women.
article.articleSummary: 5–15% of children born to mothers who had Zika fever during pregnancy develop complications, including congenital Zika syndrome, microcephaly, or Guillain-Barré syndrome. Dr. Murad Shakhmardanov notes the link between Zika and microcephaly was first described during the 2015 Americas outbreak; the WHO confirms Zika infection can trigger Guillain-Barré syndrome, neuropathy, and myelitis in adults and children. Congenital Zika also involves brain structural abnormalities, vision and hearing impairment, and delays in motor and cognitive development. Studies indicate long-term immunological disorders may appear even in infants without apparent birth defects, necessitating extended follow-up. Pregnancy infection can lead to fetal loss, stillbirth, and preterm birth. Russia reported an imported Zika case in September: a woman returning from Bali to Moscow (Indonesia).

triage.headline_ja: シャフマルダノフ医師、妊婦のジカ熱合併症について解説
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、ジカ熱の合併症に関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、ロシアでの輸入症例1件に言及するのみでシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はジカ熱の医学的合併症に関する教育的内容が中心。輸入症例（モスクワ在住女性がバリ島から帰国後発症）が唯一の具体的事例であり、インドネシア（バリ島）が感染地として言及されているため地域検証対象とした。新規アウトブレイクの兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: casos disparam no Rio, e governo anuncia reforço de vacinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Cases Spike in Rio de Janeiro, and Government Announces Vaccine Booster Campaign.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) cases spike in Rio de Janeiro. In the capital, 74 infections were confirmed over the last two months (45 in September, 29 in October), more than seven times the 10 cases recorded in the same period of 2025, with September the peak month in three years. Ten patients are hospitalized with mpox at the Fiocruz Evandro Chagas Institute of Infectology in Manguinhos, in the city’s north zone. The disease, caused by a virus, commonly presents with fever, body pains, and skin lesions that can develop into blisters; transmission is mainly through direct contact with lesions, bodily fluids, secretions, or contaminated objects. Health Minister Alexandre Padilha says the federal government has intensified vaccine shipments to Rio and maintains active surveillance with states and municipalities, with vaccination still directed to groups at risk. Brazil has 665 mpox cases this year; the 2022 outbreak neared 11,000 infections.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:リオデジャネイロで症例急増、政府はワクチン接種強化を発表
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロでMpox症例が前年同期比7倍に急増し、入院患者も発生。異常な増加かつ公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健省が公式にワクチン増派を発表しており、国内での対応は継続中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 5340 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo rises to 5,340.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of October 29, 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 5,340 deaths out of 10,351 confirmed cases, for a case fatality rate of 51.6%. The update, published by the ministry via its website from Kinshasa, indicates an ongoing outbreak with a high mortality burden. The report provides only aggregate counts; no detail on symptoms, transmission, laboratory confirmation methods beyond 'confirmed' status, or infection sources. There is no mention of imported or exported cases in this brief.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ死者数が5,340人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 致死率51.6%、感染者10,351人・死者5,340人という大規模なエボラ流行であり、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は集計データのみで、症状・感染経路・検査方法・輸入/輸出症例の詳細は不明。致死率が極めて高く、継続的な流行拡大の可能性があるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mesmo aeroporto liga casos de ebola no Quênia e na Nigéria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even the airport links Ebola cases in Kenya and Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Two early Ebola cases in Kenya and Nigeria may be linked by a shared stop at Entebbe International Airport in Uganda on October 3, raising questions about Uganda’s role as transit point or exposure site, though Kampala reports no active cases. Africa CDC says both patients were at Entebbe on the same day; no confirmed meeting or transmission there. In Nigeria, a woman who had recently traveled across East Africa, including Uganda, developed symptoms on October 7, tested positive in Abuja, and led to 44 contacts being identified. Switzerland disputes Uganda’s account that the Nigerian case had traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo, suggesting infection could have occurred during a trip to Uganda, though evidence is lacking. The Congo outbreak totals over 10,351 infections and 5,026 deaths (case fatality ~48.6%), with 84.5% contact tracing. Kenya reports a case who died in Nairobi on October 5; investigators seek a Ugandan contact amid border-control limitations and a 2–21 day incubation period.

triage.headline_ja: 同じ空港がケニアとナイジェリアのエボラ症例を結びつける
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起源とする大規模エボラ流行（感染者10,351人、死者5,026人、致死率約48.6%）が、空路を介してケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへ拡大した可能性が報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでの新規症例とその空港を介した関連性だが、背景として引用されているDRCの大規模流行（対象国リストに該当）の数値情報が事件全体の文脈として重要であるため含めた。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Muertes por ébola en el Congo superan las 5.000; crece preocupación por propagación en toda África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deaths from Ebola in the Congo exceed 5,000; concern grows over the spread across Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 31, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 5,026 deaths among 10,351 infections (case fatality ~49%), with 2,788 recoveries. The outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has no vaccine or specific treatment; care is symptom-based. It is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that killed about 11,000 across multiple countries. Since May, transmission has reached 67 of 178 health zones in eight of 26 provinces; Ituri and North Kivu constitute the epicenters with 9,782 confirmed cases and 4,792 deaths in those areas. About 80% of new cases arise outside monitored contact chains, and a third of deaths occur before treatment. Health-worker strikes over unpaid salaries and attacks on facilities, amid regional conflict, hinder responses; cases have been reported in neighboring African nations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱による死者数が5,000人を超える;アフリカ全土での拡大への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は死者5,000人超・致死率約49%に達し、史上2番目に深刻な流行となっている。近隣国への感染拡大、紛争・医療従事者のストライキによる対応の困難さがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、ワクチン・特異的治療法がない点が特に懸念される。近隣アフリカ諸国での症例報告があるが具体的な対象国名は記事に明記されていないため、DRC以外の対象国リストには該当なし。Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Residentes incendian centro de tratamiento de ébola en RD del Congo - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents set fire to an Ebola treatment center in the DRC - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: Ebola treatment center was attacked and burned by unknown individuals in Bafwasende, Tsopo province, central-northern Democratic Republic of Congo. The blaze damaged two isolation rooms; staff fled and patients were evacuated to Nia-Nia in neighboring Ituri. The incident follows a week after a mob lynched a health worker involved in Ebola response. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, has sickened over 10,000 people and killed more than 5,000 since mid-May across eight provinces, with current tallies at 10,351 cases and 5,026 deaths. Nigeria activated containment after identifying two suspected cases in the northeast; both are under strict isolation. An imported case was confirmed October 20 in a Swiss-Ugandan who contracted the virus after visiting Uganda; genomic data align with a Kenyan case, suggesting possible cross-traffic at Entebbe airport on October 3. Elsewhere, nine cases in Kenya, one in France, and three evacuees to the Netherlands and Germany. WHO is testing two experimental vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療センターが住民により放火される - teleSUR
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（1万人以上感染、5千人以上死亡）が複数国に拡大しており、治療センター焼き討ちなど対応阻害要因も発生しているため、IHR基準複数該当でフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ治療センター焼き討ちと大規模アウトブレイクを主題としている。ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ、フランス、オランダ、ドイツ等は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。本件はIHR通知済みの既知アウトブレイクの継続・悪化事象であり、社会的混乱（放火・リンチ）が対応を阻害している点が新たな懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Health Authorities Probe Two Suspected Ebola Cases In Northeast Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in northeast Nigeria after the country’s first Ebola case in more than a decade, reported on October 20. Authorities have isolated the two individuals while contact tracing and laboratory testing proceed, with results awaited to confirm infection per the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention. This develops amid an ongoing Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where North Kivu and Ituri have seen deaths among frontline workers. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention has urged stronger protection for frontline staff following the deaths of two young Congolese doctors. DRC officials cite persistent weaknesses in early detection and contact tracing, with only about 12% of confirmed cases identified among known contacts and many deaths occurring in communities. Nigeria continues investigations as the regional Bundibugyo outbreak persists.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア北東部でエボラ出血熱の疑い例2件を保健当局が調査
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し医療従事者の死亡も発生、さらにナイジェリアで10年ぶりの感染例後に疑い例が出ており、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の高さからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしDRCでの継続的アウトブレイクとの関連性が高く、国境を越えた拡大の懸念材料として記載。Ituri州はDRC国内のためDRCに統合。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 【7歲女童染甲流危殆】併發敗血性休克留PICU　同班3學童亦現病徵　今季28宗童重症2死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-year-old girl with H1N1 influenza in critical condition, complicated by septic shock and admitted to PICU; three classmates in the same class are also showing symptoms; this season there have been 28 pediatric severe cases and 2 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports a laboratory-confirmed influenza A (H1N1) infection in a 7-year-old girl who developed septic shock and is critically ill in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit. The child, with a chronic underlying condition, initially had runny nose, diarrhea, and abdominal pain on Oct 29; by Oct 30 she experienced fever and seizures and was admitted to hospital, later moved to the pediatric ICU for aggressive treatment. Household contacts are asymptomatic; three classmates have mild influenza-like symptoms but were not hospitalized. The patient had not received the 2026/27 seasonal flu vaccine. Since late June, Hong Kong has been in flu season for about four months. Cumulative figures: 28 pediatric severe influenza cases this season, with 20 recovered/discharged, 2 stable, 4 critical (including this case), and 2 deaths. Unvaccinated children have ~5× higher risk of severe complications; authorities urge vaccination, early medical care for warning signs, and infection-control measures in schools and care facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 【7歳女児がA型インフルエンザに感染し重篤】敗血性ショックを併発しPICUに入院　同じクラスの3人の児童にも症状　今シーズン小児重症例28件、死亡2件
triage.triage_reason: 香港における季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の重症小児例で、学校内での同級生の軽症例も報告されているが、季節性インフルエンザの例年の流行範囲内であり国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクは低い。経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例であり、対象国リストのルールに基づきChina(1814991)に分類。季節性インフルエンザの通常のサーベイランス報告の一部であり、個別重症例として今後の推移（学校内クラスターの拡大有無）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: No new cases in Nigeria as two suspected cases in North-east test negative
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Yola, Adamawa State, Nigeria (a 34-year-old pilot and his wife, a medical doctor) tested negative for Ebola virus after two rounds of testing; no lab-confirmed Ebola case in Adamawa, and the index case in the Federal Capital Territory remains Nigeria’s only confirmed Ebola patient to date. Nigeria’s first 2026 case was a woman who travelled from Uganda to Abuja, positive on 20 October, and evacuated to Switzerland for treatment. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo virus; Nigeria is among five countries detecting Bundibugyo virus disease since the outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in May. The NCDC reports 62 contacts linked to the confirmed Nigerian case being monitored; WHO data as of 28 October: DRC 10,274 cases, 4,992 deaths; Kenya 9 cases, 2 deaths; Nigeria 1 confirmed case. Genomic analysis linked the Nigerian strain to Kenya’s first imported case, but this does not prove Kenya as the source.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ナイジェリア北東部で疑われた2症例が陰性、新規症例なし
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起源とするBundibugyoウイルス型エボラのアウトブレイクが複数国（DRC、ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア）に拡大しており、DRCでは1万例超・死亡約5千人という深刻な公衆衛生影響が継続している。IHR基準を複数満たし、WHO・NCDC等の国際的対応も進行中でフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はナイジェリアの疑い例陰性化だが、アウトブレイクの起源・中心地であるDRCの深刻な感染状況（10,274例、4,992死亡）が記事の重要情報として含まれるため、対象国リストにあるDRCをverified_locationsに含めた。ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 海南三亚工地爆登革热疫情 数千工人被隔离
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak at a construction site in Sanya, Hainan; thousands of workers quarantined.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak at construction sites in Sanya, Hainan, with thousands of workers placed in quarantine. In Jiyang District, multiple high-end residential projects, including Sanya Poly Tianjun, reported infections; workers estimate dozens to hundreds infected, though official totals are not released. Containment includes lockdowns of living and construction areas, 24-hour police guarding at site entrances, and mayoral on-site oversight. Some workers have been relocated to hotels and to the Sanya Hengda Meili Zhi Guan (Evergrande Beautiful Crown) community for health monitoring; hundreds are housed there, and nearby residents were not pre-notified, triggering concern for families with infants. Workers underwent repeated blood testing (up to five times) and environmental disinfection with spraying and drones. Health authorities say relocated workers tested negative at transfer, but negative results do not guarantee future safety. The timing coincides with Beijing’s CPC 20th Central Committee Fifth Plenum, heightening containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: 海南三亜の建設現場でデング熱流行、数千人の労働者が隔離
triage.triage_reason: 海南省三亜市の建設現場で大規模なデング熱流行が発生し、数千人規模の隔離措置がとられている点、及び情報非公開への懸念から社会的関心が高く、WPRO基準にも複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 北京（第五次全体会議）は政治的背景として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないため除外。感染者数・重症度に関する公式データは未公表であり、情報不足のため一部基準は「不明」とした。

article.articleHeadline: 海南三亞工地爆登革熱疫情 數千工人被隔離
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak at a construction site in Sanya, Hainan; thousands of workers quarantined.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak at multiple construction sites in Sanya, Hainan Province, has led to the quarantine of thousands of workers. The high-end Sanya Poly Tianjun project in JiYang District is reported to involve several sites with dozens to hundreds of infections, though no official total has been released. Workers are confined to living areas; some are relocated to the Meili Crown Grand Tree Hotel and nearby housing, prompting complaints from residents who were not informed. Police guard entrances 24 hours a day, and the mayor has overseen on-site containment as environmental disinfection and mosquito-control measures, including drone spraying, are implemented. Workers recount repeated blood tests (three to five) before possible resumption of work. Hundreds were moved to the nearby Sanya Hengda Meili Crown community for monitoring, with initial tests negative, though officials caution that negatives reflect sampling time only. The situation unfolds during Beijing’s CPC 20th Central Committee Fifth Plenum, signaling tighter controls.

triage.headline_ja: 海南省三亜の建設現場でデング熱流行、数千人の労働者が隔離
triage.triage_reason: 建設現場での大規模なデング熱感染により数千人規模の隔離措置が取られており、異常性・拡大性・社会的関心のいずれも認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: 北京のCPC第20期中央委員会第5回全体会議への言及は政治的文脈であり、発生地はあくまで海南省三亜市。感染者数の公式集計は未発表で、重症度・死亡例の詳細も不明。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria reports two suspected Ebola cases in northeast region
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports two suspected Ebola cases in its northeast; laboratory confirmation pending. Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case in more than a decade last week, a Swiss woman who had travelled to Uganda and then returned to Abuja; she and her husband were evacuated to Switzerland. The two suspected cases, if confirmed, could indicate local transmission within Nigeria, though authorities did not say whether they are linked to the first case. Africa’s Ebola outbreak center remains the Democratic Republic of Congo, where more than 5,000 deaths have occurred since the outbreak was declared in May; Kenya and Uganda have also reported cases. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for the Bundibugyo species driving the Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア北東部でエボラ出血熱の疑い例2件を報告
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりの確定例に続き局地感染の疑い例が出現し、背景にあるコンゴ民主共和国の大規模流行（5000人超死亡）との関連が懸念されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの疑い例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。背景として言及されているDRCの大規模流行（進行中・5000人超死亡）は対象国に該当するため含めた。スイス・ケニア・ウガンダも対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Congo supera los 5.000 muertos y provoca la peor epidemia de su historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo surpasses 5,000 deaths and triggers the worst epidemic in its history.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports its Ebola outbreak—the deadliest in the country’s history—caused by Bundibugyo virus, with 10,351 cases and 5,026 deaths. The eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu bear the heaviest burden, but transmission has reached eight provinces and 67 health zones, and cases have appeared in South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé and Bas-Uélé; neighboring countries Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria have reported imported cases, signaling regional risk. Case fatality is about 48.6–49%, and 2,788 people have recovered. A key challenge is that around 80% of new infections are detected outside existing contact tracing, hindering containment. There is no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine; vaccines and treatments exist for Zaire ebolavirus but not approved for Bundibugyo. Ongoing conflict, displacement, and health-system shortages complicate response and raise cross-border transmission concerns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者5,000人を超え史上最悪の流行に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでスーダン/ブンディブギョ型エボラが史上最悪規模（1万人超感染・5千人超死亡）となり、近隣3カ国への越境伝播も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため即時フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの輸入症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。病原体はブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスで、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death Toll In DR Congo Rises To 5,340
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has caused 5,340 deaths from 10,351 confirmed cases as of 29 October 2026, according to the DRC Ministry of Health via its website. The case fatality rate stands at 51.6%. The article notes the outbreak remains ongoing and provides no further details on affected provinces, symptoms, transmission chains, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. These official counts reflect the latest confirmed figures reported by the health ministry. Published 31 October 2026, the data are presented as the current counts for the ongoing outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ死者数が5,340人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが致死率51.6%・死者5,340人に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は死亡者数・症例数のみを報告しており、罹患州、感染経路、症状、輸入/輸出症例に関する詳細は不明。致死率51.6%と非常に高く、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se descontrola en el Congo: más de 5.000 muertos por el brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spirals out of control in Congo: over 5,000 dead from the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo variant) is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 5,026 fatalities and 10,351 confirmed cases reported as of 31 October 2026. The outbreak has affected 67 health zones across eight provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu bearing a large share of cases and deaths. The epidemic has extended to neighboring countries, with related cases identified in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda, though sustained community transmission in those countries is not yet established. Security challenges, armed conflict, and attacks on health workers hamper containment; about 80% of new infections are detected outside known contact-tracing networks, and many deaths occur before patients reach care. There is no licensed vaccine or antiviral specific to Bundibugyo ebolavirus; care is supportive, with 2,788 recoveries to date. The risk to Europe remains very low, underscoring the need for funding and international cooperation to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴで制御不能に:発生から5,000人超が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)がDRCで大規模流行し複数国に拡大、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダで関連症例が確認されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれず、かつ持続的な地域内伝播は未確立とされているため検証対象地域には含めない。DRCが主要発生国として明確。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Governo Lula reforça vacinação após aumento de casos no Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Lula government steps up vaccination after an increase in Mpox cases in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: the Health Ministry dispatched additional mpox vaccine doses to the capital after 74 infections were reported between September and October 2026 (45 in September, 29 in October), more than sevenfold the 10 cases recorded in the same period in 2025. The federal government aims to curb local transmission and prepare for year-end mass gatherings. Health Minister Alexandre Padilha rejected labeling this a national outbreak, noting 665 mpox cases in Brazil so far in 2026, far below the nearly 11,000 cases seen in 2022. Vaccination remains targeted, not routine in the National Immunization Program, focusing on laboratory workers handling the virus, people living with HIV with immunosuppression, and individuals with medium- or high-risk direct exposure to a suspected or confirmed case. Mpox presents with fever, body aches and malaise, followed by skin lesions that may progress to blisters; transmission is via direct contact with lesions, body fluids, secretions, or contaminated objects. Those with compatible symptoms and exposure should seek diagnosis and follow-up in the public health system.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：リオデジャネイロでの感染増加を受け、ルラ政権がワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロでのmpox症例が前年同期比7倍に増加し、政府がワクチン追加配布と年末大型イベントへの対応を進めており、公的機関・メディアの関心も高いため、WPRO基準複数該当と社会的関心の両面からピックアップ対象とする。
triage.notes: 保健省は『全国的アウトブレイク』ではないと否定しており、2026年の全国症例数（665例）は2022年（約11,000例）を大きく下回る。ただしリオデジャネイロでの局地的増加（前年比7倍）と年末イベント前のワクチン強化対応が注目点。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة الوفيات بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 5340
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 5,340.
article.articleSummary: As of October 29, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 10,351 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 5,340 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate of 51.6%. The figures are from the DRC Ministry of Health and were published from Kinshasa via the Saudi Press Agency, with the update dated November 1, 2026. The data indicate an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the country with a high mortality burden among confirmed infections. The report provides counts but offers limited detail on clinical symptoms, transmission chains, or district-level distribution within the DRC, and does not specify laboratory methods beyond “confirmed.” The update underscores the continued severity of the outbreak and the need for sustained surveillance and public health response measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が5,340人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が1万人超の確定症例、致死率51.6%と深刻な公衆衛生被害を示しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさに該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率51.6%と高く、症例数も1万人を超える大規模流行。臨床詳細や地域別分布、感染経路の情報は限定的で続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Investigates Two Suspected Ebola Cases In Northeast As Health Authorities Expand Surveillance | Naija247news
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-31, Nigeria's NCDC reported two suspected Ebola infections in the northeast, with individuals isolated as contact tracing and laboratory testing proceed. This follows the confirmation of Nigeria's first Ebola case in more than a decade—a Swiss woman who had traveled to Uganda—whose husband was evacuated to Switzerland. It is not yet known whether the two suspected cases are connected to the Swiss patient; confirmation will depend on laboratory results. If confirmed, local transmission could be possible as investigations continue. Authorities have expanded surveillance amid a wider Ebola outbreak in Central and East Africa, led by the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the Bundibugyo virus strain is responsible and for which there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, and contaminated materials. Nigeria's priority is to confirm cases, identify exposures, and prevent further transmission via labs and contact tracing; Uganda and Kenya are coordinating surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア北東部で疑わしいエボラ出血熱症例2件を調査、保健当局がサーベイランスを拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症であり、中部・東アフリカ（コンゴ民主共和国主導）での広域アウトブレイクを背景にナイジェリアで疑い例が発生し国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの疑い例調査だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・スイス・モザンビークは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国（ブンディブギョ株）は実際に進行中のアウトブレイクの発生源として記載されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل 5340 وفاة وأكثر من 10 آلاف إصابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records 5,340 deaths and more than 10,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). As of October 29, the Ministry of Health reports 10,351 confirmed infections and 5,340 deaths, a case fatality rate of 51.6%. The outbreak continues to spread across the DRC and threatens neighboring countries, according to Africa CDC Director-General Jan Kasia. The conflict-affected region has endured armed conflict for about 30 years and faces substantial humanitarian needs. The United Nations said on August 21 that additional resources are urgently required to control the epidemic amid those conditions. The report reflects continuing transmission within the country and growing international concern about the outbreak in a fraught humanitarian setting.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、5,340人の死亡者と1万人以上の感染者を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで致死率51.6%、1万人以上の感染と5千人超の死亡、国際的拡大懸念と人道危機が重なりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Africa CDCや国連が言及しており、近隣国への拡大リスクと紛争地域での人道支援の必要性が強調されている。致死率51.6%は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Afrikada Ebola kabusu: Ölənlərin sayı beş mini keçdi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola nightmare in Africa: The death toll has surpassed five thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 5,000 laboratory-confirmed deaths, with total infections at 10,351 and a case fatality rate of 48.6%. The outbreak began mid-May in both Uganda and the DRC, with eight DRC provinces reporting infections and related deaths. Uganda declared the outbreak over on July 28, a determination confirmed by the World Health Organization on August 25. However, the situation later intensified, with Kenya reporting its first Ebola case on October 6 and Nigeria reporting its first case on October 20. As of November 1, 2026, the DRC outbreak remains the second-largest Ebola epidemic in African history by death toll, reflecting ongoing transmission within multiple provinces.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ悪夢:死者数が5000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ死者数が5000人を超え、致死率48.6%と深刻。ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアも発生地域に含まれるが、いずれも対象国リストに該当しないため除外。致死率48.6%、感染者10,351人、死者5000人超とアフリカ史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行であり、複数国への拡大が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động phòng bệnh não mô cầu từ những dấu hiệu sớm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactively Prevent Meningococcal Disease by Recognizing Early Signs.
article.articleSummary: Two significant meningococcal disease deaths (Neisseria meningitidis group B) occurred in Ca Mau, with linked cases in Can Tho, Mekong Delta, since early 2026. On Oct 23 and Oct 28, two women from Sông Đốc commune died from meningitis/septicemia, infection source undetermined. Transmission is via respiratory droplets and close contact; high risk in crowded, enclosed spaces such as schools and workplaces. Early symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue, nausea, and loss of appetite; progression can be rapid, with cold extremities, skin petechiae, weakness, neck stiffness, altered mental status, or shock within 24 hours. Can Tho’s health authorities have intensified surveillance, treatment, and vaccination promotion. Vaccines from various manufacturers are available, priced roughly from 230,000 to 1.8 million VND, but protection varies by serogroup; vaccination should be guided by health professionals. Close contacts require health monitoring (about 10 days) and may receive antibiotic prophylaxis; vaccination does not substitute post-exposure measures or precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 早期の兆候から髄膜炎菌感染症を積極的に予防する
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・カマウ省で髄膜炎菌感染症（血清群B）による死亡例が2件発生し、カントーでも関連症例が確認されている。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、保健当局が監視・ワクチン接種を強化していることから、公衆衛生上の懸念とスクリーニング基準の該当がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域はすべてベトナム国内（カマウ省、カントー市）。感染源は特定されておらず、続報での感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lumpy skin disease resurfaces in Faridkot after four years, farmers question vaccination drive
article.articleSummary: Lumpy skin disease (LSD) resurfaces in Faridkot district, Punjab, after nearly four years, with cases across villages and gaushalas. The flare follows a vaccination drive three months earlier, prompting scrutiny of cold-chain handling. Infections in multiple households: Jatinder Singh (Arianwala) with three; Bohar Singh (Ratti Rori) with two; Bazigar Basti; Balwant Singh (Machaki Khurd). Gaushalas in Faridkot and Golewala report cases; Nathewala’s Gagan Singh has two, with two cattle deaths in Nangal. Golewala gaushala houses ~380 animals, with four workers; 25 acres of land (15 fodder), but shortages of seeds and fertilisers limit green fodder. Calves below four months are not vaccinated, heightening susceptibility. Dr Jaswinder Singh, Deputy Director, confirms cases and says reports are sent to state and central authorities. Symptoms: fever, skin nodules, watery eyes, increased secretions; milk loss and death possible.

triage.headline_ja: ファリドコットでランピースキン病が4年ぶりに再発、農家がワクチン接種活動に疑問
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（牛のランピースキン病）であり人の公衆衛生への直接影響は限定的だが、ワクチン接種体制やコールドチェーンの問題が指摘されており、畜産業への影響や拡大の可能性から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 動物（牛）の感染症であり人獣共通感染症ではないため人への公衆衛生リスクは低い。パキスタンは記事サマリー中に言及がなく、発生地域リストに含まれるが主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam Morning Monitor: 2 fatal meningococcal cases' infection source still unknown, thousands of Ho Chi Minh City students learn to guard against online scams
article.articleSummary: Two fatal meningococcal disease deaths in Song Doc Commune, Ca Mau Province, Vietnam. Ca Mau Center for Disease Control said investigations are ongoing and there is no evidence that the deaths are linked or stem from a common infection source. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation, symptoms, exposure history, or travel links. Authorities continue surveillance for additional cases, with no broader meningococcal outbreak or imported/exported case information disclosed. The report emphasizes public health monitoring rather than treatment or vaccination actions, highlighting the need for vigilance in Ca Mau.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム朝のモニター：2件の致死的髄膜炎菌感染症、感染源は依然不明、ホーチミン市の数千人の学生がオンライン詐欺対策を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: カマウ省で髄膜炎菌感染症による死亡例が2件確認されたが、感染源・関連性は不明で、広範な流行の証拠もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 死亡例2件のみで感染源・検査確定情報が不足。カマウ省CDCが調査中であり、追加症例のサーベイランスが継続されている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde reforça vacinas contra mpox no Rio após 74 casos em dois meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health steps up mpox vaccination in Rio de Janeiro after 74 cases in two months
article.articleSummary: Mpox vaccination was boosted in Rio de Janeiro after 74 mpox cases between September and October 2026. In 2026 Brazil recorded 665 mpox cases, far below 2022's nearly 11,000. Health Minister Alexandre Padilha said there is no surge comparable to 2022; the additional doses to Rio aim to curb transmission. Vaccination is not part of the National Immunization Program and is recommended only for specific groups: laboratory workers handling the virus, people living with HIV with immunosuppression, and individuals with direct medium- to high-risk exposure to suspected or confirmed cases. Mpox is a viral illness that often presents with mild symptoms but requires surveillance to prevent spread. Early signs include fever, headache, muscle pains, and skin lesions.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、2ヶ月で74例のMpox症例発生を受けリオデジャネイロでワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロで2ヶ月74例のMpox症例増加が報告されワクチン強化が行われたが、保健省は2022年のような急増ではないと明言しており、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。HIV感染者など免疫不全者への拡大懸念があるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（リオデジャネイロ州）のMpox症例増加とワクチン接種強化についての内容。保健大臣は2022年のような大規模流行ではないと明言しており、全国的に見ても2026年の累計665例は2022年の約11,000例を大きく下回る。HIV免疫不全者など特定リスク群への感染拡大が今後の注視点。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm gia tăng, coi chừng ngộ độc gan do uống thuốc cảm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu cases on the rise; beware of liver toxicity from taking cold medicines.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza cases are rising in Phu Tho Province, Vietnam, with nearly 30 hospitalizations at Phu Tho General Hospital, up about 70% from the prior month. Clinicians warn that combining fever reducers and cough/cold medicines can lead to accidental paracetamol (acetaminophen) overdose, risking acute liver injury or failure. Paracetamol is common in many products, so taking multiple medications with the same active ingredient or increasing doses can exceed safe limits, especially when early overdose shows few symptoms. At-risk individuals include those with liver disease, heavy alcohol use, malnutrition, or those on multiple drugs. Safety measures emphasize checking ingredients, avoiding overlap of paracetamol-containing products, following labeled doses, and seeking urgent medical care if overdose is suspected—even if asymptomatic. For children, doses must be weight-based; caregivers should carry medication lists when seeking care.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ増加、風邪薬による肝毒性に注意
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの季節的増加と薬剤誤用による肝障害リスクに関する注意喚起記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザによる入院増加と、解熱鎮痛薬・風邪薬の重複服用によるパラセタモール過剰摂取のリスクについての一般的な医療啓発記事。感染症の異常発生ではなく薬剤安全性に関する内容。

article.articleHeadline: INS confirma dos casos de malaria en viajeros procedentes de África: uno falleció
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: INS confirms two cases of malaria in travelers from Africa: one died.
article.articleSummary: Two Colombian travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo were diagnosed with malaria in Valle del Cauca, Colombia, both infected with Plasmodium falciparum. The 33-year-old died on October 31 at a Palmira hospital; the 50-year-old remains under medical care and isolation in Cali. Public health authorities activated epidemiological surveillance to trace travel routes, exposures, and potential contacts, and to rule out other diseases of public health interest, including Ebola. Laboratory confirmation continues to indicate malaria, with ongoing testing and verification. INS and Valle del Cauca health authorities are conducting investigations in Cali and Palmira to identify exposure points and contact networks. Two additional individuals identified during the initial investigation reportedly have malaria and are under treatment. The Ministry of Health and INS coordinate with hospitals and territorial authorities to ensure care and testing, with updates to be provided through official channels.

triage.headline_ja: INS、アフリカ帰りの旅行者2名のマラリア感染を確認：うち1名死亡
triage.triage_reason: 本事例はコロンビア国内で診断された輸入マラリア症例であり、DRCは渡航元として言及されているのみで同国内での発生事象ではない。対象国リストに該当する国での発生は確認できないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はコロンビア（対象国リスト外）での輸入マラリア症例およびエボラ鑑別診断に関する報告。DRCは患者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、同国内での感染症発生事象を報じたものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل 5340 وفاة و10351 إصابة بفيروس "إيبولا" | القاهرة الاخبارية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records 5,340 deaths and 10,351 infections from the Ebola virus | Cairo News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains severe, with 10,351 confirmed infections and 5,340 deaths as of October 29, a case fatality rate of 51.6%. Transmission continues across a country long beset by armed conflict, prompting concern for neighboring nations, including Uganda. Africa CDC Director-General John Kasia warned that Ebola threatens neighboring states as the outbreak persists nationwide. The United Nations in August appealed for additional resources to control the epidemic. A Nature Medicine study identifies the outbreak as caused by a previously unknown Bundibugyo lineage, likely spillover from animals to humans. The World Health Organization first declared the DRC-Uganda situation a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, with regional risk assessed as high. The report underscores ongoing transmission and international concern, highlighting containment efforts and resource needs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルスで5,340人死亡、10,351人感染を記録 | カイロ・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 致死率51.6%の大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言済みで、国際的拡大懸念と資源支援の必要性が明確であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの波及懸念が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。新規のBundibugyo系統による未知の動物由来感染である点も注目点。

article.articleHeadline: Εφιάλτης χωρίς τέλος στη Λαϊκή Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό: Πάνω από 5.000 νεκροί από το φονικότερο ξέσπασμα Έμπολα στη χώρα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Never-Ending Nightmare in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 5,000 Dead from the Deadliest Ebola Outbreak in the Country.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is battling the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, with over 5,000 deaths and about 10,300 confirmed cases across eight of its 26 provinces. Northeastern Ituri province is the epicenter amid armed conflict, complicating access and control measures. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved treatment or specialized vaccine. The case fatality rate stands at 48.6%. The World Health Organization has called for an immediate scale-up of international aid, safer access to affected areas, and expanded diagnostics and clinical trials. Violence against responders compounds the crisis: a nurse was killed and a colleague seriously injured; a politician beaten to death; the Red Cross reports multiple attacks. Internationally, Kenya has 9 cases and 2 deaths; Nigeria reports one imported case airlifted to Switzerland; Uganda maintains border restrictions. ECDC says Europe risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 終わりの見えない悪夢：コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪のエボラ流行、死者5,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%、死者5,000人超の過去最悪規模のエボラ流行で、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当が認められる。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイス・ウガンダへの越境事例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（DRCのみ対象国）。武力紛争による対応困難化、治療薬・ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株による流行で、国際支援が強く求められている状況。

article.articleHeadline: 護理師慘遭殺害！宣傳防疫也被打死　民主剛果伊波拉逾5000死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nurse brutally murdered! Even those promoting epidemic prevention were beaten to death; Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 5,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, centers in Ituri Province (northeast) where armed conflict hampers response. Since May, the outbreak has killed over 5,000 and surpassed 10,300 confirmed infections across 8 of 26 provinces (case fatality rate ~48.6%). This is DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. WHO Africa region warns that containment requires expanded control measures, safer access for healthcare workers, and strengthened community education; there is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo, though vaccines are in clinical trials. Security issues hinder control efforts, including fatal assaults on responders and distrust fueled by misinformation. Transnational spread includes Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths) and Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths); Nigeria reported one confirmed case in October, with a suspected second, and a case treated in Switzerland. Europe’s risk remains very low per ECDC; UN calls for intensified international support.

triage.headline_ja: 護理師が惨殺される！防疫啓発活動中にも殺害被害　民主コンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者5000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が5000人以上の死者・10,300人超の感染者を出し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大）を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイスでの症例も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（ナイジェリアとウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに非該当）。武力紛争とミスインフォメーションにより対応が困難化しており、致死率約48.6%と非常に高い。17回目の流行で2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行に次ぐ規模。

article.articleHeadline: Murió un colombiano que llegó del Congo con malaria: autoridades investigan y descartan otras enfermedades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Colombian who arrived from the Congo died of malaria: authorities are investigating and ruling out other diseases.
article.articleSummary: Two Colombian citizens arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo were diagnosed with malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum in Valle del Cauca, Colombia. One patient, 33, died on October 31 in Palmira; the other, 50, remains alive, isolated, and receiving care in Cali. Health authorities activated epidemiological surveillance to exclude other public health threats, including Ebola, due to travel history and febrile symptoms. Laboratory tests are underway to rule out other diseases; so far, malaria is the sole confirmed diagnosis. The National Institute of Health is conducting field investigations in Cali and Palmira to map movements and exposure, identify contacts, and determine exposure sources. Two additional individuals with malaria are under treatment and being followed. The investigation continues with coordination among the Health Ministry, INS, and local authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴから帰国したコロンビア人がマラリアで死亡：当局はエボラなど他疾患の可能性を調査・除外中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）は患者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、実際の発症・死亡はコロンビアで発生しており、対象国リストに該当する国での発生事例ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本事例はコンゴ民主共和国から帰国したコロンビア人における輸入マラリア症例であり、発症国はコロンビア（対象国リスト外）。DRCは渡航元としての言及のみでDRC国内での発生事例ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。エボラは検査により除外される見込み。

article.articleHeadline: Ministerio de Salud confirma dos casos de malaria en pacientes procedentes de la República Democrática del Congo: intensifica vigilancia en Colombia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health confirms two malaria cases in patients from the Democratic Republic of the Congo: intensifies surveillance in Colombia.
article.articleSummary: Two Colombian citizens with recent travel from the Democratic Republic of the Congo were diagnosed with Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Valle del Cauca, Colombia, triggering intensified surveillance on 31 October 2026. One patient, 33, died in Palmira; the other, 50, remains alive in isolation in Cali. Rapid response teams from the Ministry of Health and National Institute of Health are conducting field investigations in Cali and Palmira to trace travel routes in Africa and potential exposure sites, with sample collection and laboratory verification underway. Given international travel and febrile symptoms, protocols to rule out other high-priority diseases, including Ebola, have been activated. The case suggests imported malaria and prompts ongoing epidemiological monitoring in the department of Valle del Cauca to prevent secondary transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、コンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者2名にマラリア感染を確認：コロンビアで監視強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者がコロンビアで輸入マラリアと診断された個別症例であり、DRC国内でのアウトブレイク情報はない。エボラ疑いは除外検査中で未確定のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCとコロンビアが含まれるが、実際の発症はコロンビア国内（輸入症例）であり、DRC国内でのアウトブレイクを示す記述はないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国なしと判断。エボラについては除外検査中の段階であり確定情報ではない。
